In this debut adult memoir, readers are invited to witness untrodden ground as George navigates an HIV diagnosis, alcoholism, tremendous loss, and nationwide book bans over the span of 15 years. Through the highs and lows of life in the spotlight, they have clung to family and community like never before -- finding their most authentic self along the way. Drawing inspiration from Toni Morrison, Jesmyn Ward, and Ta-Nehisi Coates, And If I Die Before I Wake explores grief, trauma, sexuality, and the Black family through the lens of transformation, healing, and hope. Poetic, grounded, and bursting with signature humor, this is New York Times-bestselling author George M. Johnson more bold, more brave, and more daring than ever -- ready to share a new part of their journey with the world.

books.title: Ruthless Prey
books.author: John Sandford
books.desc: When the mother of Lucas Davenport's child is found dead in the backyard of her family home, nestled in an old affluent suburb in Minneapolis, the authorities immediately rule it a suicide. But Lucas is not as convinced. Lucas begins to investigate the case and learns that Jennifer's news team had been working on some controversial stories, suggesting to Lucas considerable animus by their targets. But as more bodies start to pile up, Lucas will need to work fast to locate the perpetrator and avenge the death of his family.

books.title: The Body in the Bath
books.author: Ragnar Jónasson
books.desc: From the author of The Mysterious Case of The Missing Crime Writer comes the next mystery featuring detective Helgi Reykdal. When Bergþóra Úlfsdóttir, Helgi’s ex-girlfriend, is found dead in her home just before Christmas, Helgi is brought onto the case—but this time, he’s a suspect of her murder, given his complicated relationship with Bergþóra. The timing is suspicious: just before her own death, Bergþóra fatally hit Helgi’s new girlfriend, Anita, with her car, ruining the future he’d hoped to build with her. Meanwhile, Helgi has also been looking into the disappearance of Hulda Hermannsdóttir; the woman who’d held his office before him supposedly died of suicide but Helgi remains unconvinced. As he digs into this old case, it begins to seem as though Hulda’s disappearance has more layers—layers that draw connections between Bergþóra’s and Anita’s deaths and Hulda’s disappearance.

books.title: The Monster Hunter's Librarian
books.author: Lauren Connolly
books.desc: Navigating the stacks of a sentient library, as well as their simmering attraction to each other, a librarian witch and a monster hunter team up to save a mystical world from destruction. As the newest hire at the Endless Library, Bells Mortevue finally has access to magic again and a chance to prove that the daughter of criminal necromancers can be trusted with power—even if it’s solely used to seek and sort books upon infinite shelves. Except a certain monster hunter refuses to let Bells do her job. Rhett Waltham doesn’t want help. Not when revealing the truth of his research would be a death sentence for his ailing human father. Preparing to risk his own life in a dangerous competition to save his dad, Rhett does not have time for a curious, tantalizing librarian witch who asks too many questions. It’s clear the Library disagrees, as the sentient space itself forces the two together. Bells warms to the grumpy hunter as she slowly earns his trust, though she starts to suspect a sickness is stirring within the walls of the mystical dimension. And when a deadly magic threatens to consume the entire Library—and the monster hunter’s librarian—Rhett won’t let either of them go without a fight.

books.title: King of Masks
books.author: Petra Lord
books.desc: The sequel to the instant New York Times bestselling dark fantasy novel, Queen of Faces, finds Ana and Nell on opposite sides of a brutal war, as an ancient horror returns. Perfect for fans of Leigh Bardugo, Brandon Sanderson, and R.F. Kuang. This deluxe edition features gorgeous gilded edges, stunning case foil, and striking printed endpapers! Anabelle Gage emerged from the ashes of Paragon Academy having done the impossible—slaying the infamous Black Wraith, and stealing her body. As Caimor and Shenten race toward all-out war, Ana will risk everything to save her loved ones caught in the crossfire. Her friend Korin has been imprisoned by a vicious Shenti warlord, and has only days to live. To save him from execution, Ana and her allies must cross rising seas and withstand enemies on all sides. Across the ocean, Nell Ebbridge is reunited with her father, Caimor's ruthless king, and find herself torn between her duty and her feelings for Ana. As she draws closer to dark truths, Nell must decide who she is willing to become—and who she is willing to sacrifice. Krakens prowl the seas and ancient horrors stir beneath the waves. As armies clash and loyalties fracture, Ana and Nell are set on a devastating collision course.

books.title: Last Ride
books.author: Craig Alanson
books.desc: The Pirates destroyed the enemy, cut off their access to the Milky Way. Against all odds, Joe, Skippy, and the Merry Band of Pirates pulled off yet another impossible mission. They should be celebrating. Unfortunately, the dying enemy had one final act of spite. Now an unstoppable force is consuming the galaxy. Coalitions are collapsing. Chaos is spreading, including on Earth. And Joe Bishop has more problems than even he can personally deal with. So while everyone else deals with the increasingly violent chaos, Joe, Skippy, and the Pirates have to tackle the actual enemy: the laws of physics. And unfortunately, even Skippy can't argue with those. So when the fate of the galaxy comes down to one last solution, there's only one thing left to deploy. Filthy monkeys. Craig Alanson's epic Expeditionary Force saga concludes in book 20. Get ready for Last Ride, narrated as always by the one and only R.C. Bray.

books.title: Big Math
books.subtitle: The Hidden Codes That Run Our World
books.author: Steven Strogatz
books.desc: It’s in every photo you post to Instagram, every Google search you make, and every answer you get back from ChatGPT. It routes our packages and planes, maps social networks, and predicts the weather. This is Big Math, and it is quietly running our world—while also reshaping it in ways we can’t yet comprehend. A toolkit of powerful ideas such as matrices and vectors, networks and optimization, Big Math allows humanity to tackle problems too vast to hold in our heads. Yet the tools themselves are not especially new or mysterious. We created them, and for most of their history we understood them and controlled them. But once we began supercharging them with computers to explore truly enormous systems, things changed. Now, as celebrated mathematicians Steven Strogatz and Alex Townsend reveal in this dazzling and unsettling book, Big Math is beginning to drift beyond our grasp, even as it delivers greater gifts and power through machine learning and, soon, quantum computing. What happens when Big Math outgrows its creators—when it becomes something we no longer understand, but only witness? And how can we learn to live wisely with tools that grow stronger and stranger every day?
